aboutPreview.title: Rooted in Tradition, Growing for the Future
aboutPreview.description: AfriNuts Export is a family-owned agribusiness based in Odienné, Ivory Coast. With over 35 hectares of prime cashew farmland, we combine traditional farming knowledge with modern sustainable practices to produce premium quality cashews for global markets. Learn how we grow organic cashews without chemicals in our farm blog.

farm.title: Our 35-Hectare Organic Cashew Farm in Odienné
farm.description: Located in the heart of Ivory Coast's cashew belt, our family farm spans 35 hectares with over 3,500 cashew trees planted. We combine traditional knowledge passed down through generations with modern organic farming practices. Every tree is hand-tended. Every harvest is tracked. From land clearing to your table, we control the entire process.

sustainability.title: Organic. Ethical. Traceable. Our Sustainability Promise.
sustainability.description: At AfriNuts Export, we believe great cashews come from healthy land and happy people. That's why every decision we make considers the environment, our workers, and the community. Our farm is on track for organic certification in 2026, and we pay fair wages above regional standards.

features.title: Organic Farming
features.description: No synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. Our soil is tested regularly to ensure purity.

features.title: Fair Trade Practices
features.description: Ethical treatment, fair wages, and safe working conditions for all workers. We pay above minimum wage.

features.title: Zero Waste Processing
